page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Left margin holds two notes beside Canon 2 and Canon 4. The right edge shows part of the neighbouring page, which is not transcribed.

main_text.p: Antediluviana, nisi quantum Moses tradit, ignoratur.
main_text.head: Explicatio 1.
main_text.p: Imperium unum commemoratur fundatum à Kaino, cujus regia sedes fuit Urbs Hanoch; Sed incertum est, in qua regione sita, ubi septem ordine Reges, ejus posteri, regnârunt; ut Augustinus tradit.
main_text.head: Explic. 2.
main_text.p: Quod verò Abydenus & Apollodorus aliud quoddam regnum Chaldæorum, ejusque Reges ab Aloro ad Xisuthrum sive Noachum referunt, fabulosum est.
Postdiluviana est vel Anti-qua vel Nova.Post di- luviana

page.notes: The "Ex-" at the lower right is a catchword, the first syllable of the next page. The note "Post di- luviana" stands beside the last line of Canon 4. The right-hand scan edge shows the neighbouring page and is omitted. Short line-end hyphen in "Anti-qua" is kept as printed.
